act.name: Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971
act.source_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing lawful medical termination of pregnancy, approved places and privacy safeguards.

sections.title: When pregnancies may be terminated by registered medical practitioners.
sections.text: Section 3 sets the statutory circumstances and medical-opinion requirements for termination of pregnancy; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Pregnancy may be terminated by a registered medical practitioner when the statutory conditions and applicable gestational requirements are met.
